summary: Batch4-p1 (commits 829452d tests, c5f57d5 word bank, 98d3bdf chrome promotion) fully meets the task intent and both verification gates are green: `flutter test` = 47 passed and `flutter build web` prints `Built build\web` (the trailing Exit Code 1 is only the Wasm dry-run stderr warning after the Built line, not a compile failure). FEAT-001 adds six deterministic, meaningful test files (seeded Random + mocked SharedPreferences) that assert the real behaviors described: streak same-day no-op / consecutive-increment / gap-reset / previous-calendar-day boundary; mission forDay determinism, clamp-to-target, ignore-non-matching-metric, claim-once payout, and midnight rollover; level-unlock gating across all five GameProgressStore maps plus Number Quest's standalone GameState; completeLevel star boundaries at 49/50/69/70/89/90 with keep-best and fastest-only-on-3-star-and-improving; type-aware generator forLevel structure (4 distinct choices per type, setClock skipped, whichMore exactly 2 piles with the richer pile as correct, correctIndex in range and pointing at the correct value); and NQ math correctness (division whole by construction, subtraction never negative, no negative choices, answer present in choices) swept over seeds 0..60 and forced expert rounds. Verified against source: problem_generator builds division as divisor*quotient, clamps subtraction via nextInt(a)+1, and _buildChoices filters negatives; game_progress_store uses the 90/70/50 thresholds and records fastest only on a 3-star run with elapsed>0 that beats the record. FEAT-002 expands the word bank to 75 real, lowercase, age-appropriate words (25 easy/25 medium/25 hard) each with a fitting distinct emoji; the WordEntry(word,emoji) shape and easy/medium/hard/forDifficulty/allWords API are unchanged, all three question types and the TTS spokenWord getter keep working, and the deferred 4th type is documented as a Future-work comment. FEAT-003 promotes six core widgets with pixel/behavior-identical swaps: GameHeader, RewardRow, and ResultBanner match the originals byte-for-byte (verified by diff against the pre-batch commit), the AnimatedBuilder/Listenable.merge wrappers and both profile.setSoundOn+state.setSoundOn calls are preserved, the 'Your time' TimerChip row and summary/StarRow(size:44) were correctly left inline, Number Quest's richer home/header/result variants were left untouched, and the trail StarRow size drift was fixed (18->17). No product bugs were found or needed fixing, and no tests were weakened to pass.
